settings.title: Trybatec options
settings.description:
Tariffs are estimates. Verify each meter in 'Verify meter units'. The legacy global heating-unit option is no longer used.

Submit to save and return to the main menu. To discard changes without saving, close this dialog using ×.

history_review.title: Choose a reading for review
history_review.description:
Run trybatec.preview_history first. Only readings from the latest preview appear.

[Open Settings → Tools → Actions]({actions_url})

The link opens with « trybatec.preview_history » selected; it does not run the action.

history_decision.title: Reading decision
history_decision.description: Original Trybatec reading remains unchanged. Decision is stored locally.

history_correction.title: Correct or attribute a reading
history_correction.description:
Only correct measurement date with evidence. Accounting attribution is a convention, not a measurement timestamp.

Submitting these fields opens the mandatory confirmation form. No draft is stored as a decision until you explicitly approve it.

history_confirm.title: Confirm reading decision

data.confirm_outside_period: I explicitly confirm the attribution outside the observed interval

meter_units.title: Select meter
meter_units.description:
Select a meter. Any previously confirmed unit is retained for that exact physical meter. Otherwise, the chart unit is proposed and can be confirmed by submitting the form. Physical meters, including replacements, remain distinct.

Chart display units are configured references; they do not prove the raw index unit is explicitly supplied by the API.

meter_unit.title: Meter index unit
meter_unit.description:
Meter: {meter}. Chart reference unit: {display_unit} (configured reference, not read live from the API). Explicit API index unit: {portal_unit}.

Preselection: {selection_origin}. A saved choice for this physical meter is retained. Otherwise, the API unit is proposed, or the chart unit if the API provides none. Select Save to confirm; no additional confirmation is required. Choose Unknown when the actual unit is unknown.

The Trybatec device UUID is optional. Saving returns to the meter list. Close this window with × to discard unsaved changes.

history_overview.title: Historical preflight
history_overview.description:
**Period:** {period}

**{meters} meters · {flagged} readings flagged for review**

- **Cold water (EF)**: {ef_meters} meter(s), {ef_gaps} gap(s), {ef_conflicts} conflict(s)
- **Hot water (ECS)**: {ecs_meters} meter(s), {ecs_gaps} gap(s), {ecs_conflicts} conflict(s)
- **Heating (CET)**: {cet_meters} meter(s), {cet_gaps} gap(s), {cet_conflicts} conflict(s)

Per-meter details are available separately in the integration options. Physical meters are never automatically merged.

[Open Developer Tools → Actions]({actions_url})

The link opens with « trybatec.preview_history » selected; it does not run the action.

history_empty.title: No readings to review
history_empty.description:
The most recent preview does not identify any readings needing a decision. This is not an error.

To refresh it, [open Developer Tools → Actions]({actions_url}) and run `trybatec.preview_history`.

The link opens with « trybatec.preview_history » selected; it does not run the action.

history_meter_detail.title: Meter details

history_meters.title: Physical meter details
history_meters.description:
Choose one of {meters} physical meters, including retired meters. Inspection does not change historical readings.

[Open Developer Tools → Actions]({actions_url})

The link opens with « trybatec.preview_history » selected; it does not run the action.

history_unavailable.title: Trybatec integration unavailable
history_unavailable.description:
The integration has not finished loading: meter indexes could not be updated. This can be a portal connection or response-format problem; it does not mean saved review decisions were deleted.

[Open Trybatec logs]({logs_url})

After recovery, [open Developer Tools → Actions]({actions_url}) to run `trybatec.preview_history`.

The link opens with « trybatec.preview_history » selected; it does not run the action.

history_preview_missing.title: Historical preview required
history_preview_missing.description:
No active historical preview is available (including after restart or reload). Previously saved decisions remain stored.

[Open Developer Tools → Actions]({actions_url}) and run `trybatec.preview_history`, then return here.

If the action fails, [open Trybatec logs]({logs_url}).

The link opens with « trybatec.preview_history » selected; it does not run the action.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics and logging
diagnostics.description:
Choose the Trybatec log severity. This level applies to all Trybatec hubs in the Home Assistant instance. WARNING is recommended normally; DEBUG is for temporary troubleshooting. Raw portal responses, passwords and tokens must never be logged.

[Open Trybatec logs]({logs_url})

Submit to apply the selected level and return to the main menu. To discard changes without saving, close this dialog using ×.
